steps.title: Prepare consumables and plan bead volumes
steps.instruction: Gather DNA LoBind 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes and low‑retention pipette tips. Plan two pulldown rounds: first round 50 µL Oligo(dT) beads per ≥50 µg total RNA, second round 20 µL beads. Add extra 20 µL beads to cover pipetting loss.

steps.title: Prepare binding and wash buffers
steps.instruction: Make fresh buffers (scale as needed) and filter‑sterilize. For 50 mL each: Binding buffer – 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4 (1 mL of 1 M), 500 mM LiCl (3.125 mL of 8 M), 0.5 % LiDS (2.5 mL of 10 % w/v), 2 mM EDTA (200 µL of 0.5 M), water to 50 mL. Wash buffer A – same as binding but 0.2 % LiDS (1 mL of 10 % w/v). Wash buffer B – 20 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.4, 500 mM LiCl, 2 mM EDTA, water to 50 mL (no LiDS). Store ≤1 week at 4 °C; warm to room temperature if LiDS precipitates.

steps.title: Prepare primary antibody solution
steps.instruction: In 10 mL total volume mix 1× PBS with 0.1 % Tween 20, add 1 µL m6A rabbit monoclonal antibody (1:10 000) and 5 µg total m6A‑free RNA (500 ng·mL⁻¹) purified from ime4Δ yeast. Store on ice or at 4 °C during ELISA setup; do not reuse.

steps.title: Prepare secondary antibody solution
steps.instruction: In 10 mL total volume mix 1× PBS with 0.1 % Tween 20, add 2 µL goat anti‑rabbit IgG‑HRP (1:5 000). Store on ice or at 4 °C during ELISA setup; do not reuse.

steps.title: Prepare and wash Oligo(dT) beads
steps.instruction: Vortex Oligo(dT)25 magnetic beads vigorously for at least 5 min (minimum 10 s between pipetting steps). Calculate total bead volume (e.g., 50 µL × 4 samples + 20 µL = 220 µL) and transfer to a LoBind tube, vortexing between transfers. Place tube on magnetic rack ~1 min until beads separate, discard the manufacturer’s resuspension buffer. Wash beads ≥3 times with 1 mL binding buffer, then resuspend in the original bead volume of fresh binding buffer.

steps.title: Mix RNA with beads in binding buffer
steps.instruction: For each sample add 900 µL binding buffer to the total RNA (yeast: 50–80 µg, mammalian: ≥10 µg; total volume ≤100 µL). Add 50 µL of prepared beads, vortex the mixture vigorously.

steps.title: Incubate binding reaction
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a rotator wheel and rotate at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Cool reaction on ice
steps.instruction: Chill the tubes on ice for at least 2 min.

steps.title: Separate beads and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Put tubes on the magnetic rack until the solution is clear (≈1 min). Carefully pipette off and discard the binding buffer.

steps.title: Resuspend beads in Tris‑HCl
steps.instruction: After the first pulldown round resuspend beads in 55 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl; after the second round resuspend in 25 µL 10 mM Tris‑HCl.

steps.title: Elute poly(A) RNA
steps.instruction: Heat the bead suspension at 75–80 °C while mixing at 1 400 rpm in a thermomixer for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect eluate immediately
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack, quickly pipette the eluate into a fresh LoBind 1.5 mL tube. Keep eluate warm; do not allow it to cool before downstream steps.

steps.title: Quantify poly(A) RNA (optional)
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration with a Nanodrop after round 1 (yeast: 12–20 ng/µL from 50 µg, 20–35 ng/µL from 80 µg; mammalian: 4–6 ng/µL from 10 µg). After round 2 expect 12–20 ng/µL (yeast, 50 µg) or 20–35 ng/µL (yeast, 80 µg) in 25 µL, and 2–4 ng/µL (mammalian, 10 µg).

steps.title: Transcribe RNA standards
steps.instruction: Use the MEGAscript® T7 kit following the manufacturer’s protocol. For each 20 µL reaction combine: nuclease‑free water to 20 µL, 2 µL ATP (for A) or 1.5 µL N⁶‑ATP (100 mM) (for m⁶A), 2 µL each of CTP, GTP, UTP, 2 µL 10× reaction buffer, 0.1–1 µg linear DNA template, 2 µL enzyme mix. Scale volumes as needed.

steps.title: Digest template DNA
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL TURBO™ DNase to each transcription reaction and incubate at 37 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Quantify transcribed RNA
steps.instruction: Measure unmodified (A) RNA with a NanoDrop. Measure m⁶A‑modified RNA with a Qubit RNA HS assay (NanoDrop is inaccurate for m⁶A).

steps.title: Clean up RNA
steps.instruction: Purify the RNAs using the Macherey‑Nagel NucleoSpin RNA Clean‑up Mini kit according to the kit instructions.

steps.title: Aliquot and store standards
steps.instruction: Aliquot at least 1 200 ng of A RNA per tube (sufficient for three technical replicates). For m⁶A RNA, prepare 10 µL aliquots at 10 ng/µL. Store all aliquots at –80 °C.

steps.title: Add binding solution to ELISA plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 90 µL DNA‑binding microplate solution into each well of a 96‑well plate (use three technical replicates, minimum two).

steps.title: Add m6A standards
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 µL of each serially diluted m⁶A‑RNA standard (Table 2) into the appropriate wells. Each standard contains 50 ng of A RNA plus the indicated amount of m⁶A RNA.

steps.title: Load RNA samples
steps.instruction: Add yeast samples: 50 ng mRNA per well (≤10 µL volume). Add mammalian samples: 10 ng mRNA per well (≤10 µL). Mix gently with the 90 µL binding solution to a final volume of 100 µL using a multichannel pipette set to 50 µL. Avoid bubbles; remove any with a needle if needed.

steps.title: Seal plate
steps.instruction: Cover the plate with the supplied adhesive film, ensuring a tight seal to prevent evaporation.

steps.title: Incubate binding step
steps.instruction: Incubate the sealed plate at 37 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Discard binding solution
steps.instruction: Remove the liquid from each well with a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Wash plate (first series)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL PBS‑0.1 % Tween to each well, flick the plate to discard, and repeat this wash three additional times (total four washes). Tap the plate lightly on tissue to dry between washes.

steps.title: Add primary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL primary antibody solution to each well, remove bubbles by gentle tapping or a needle, and incubate at room temperature for 1 h.

steps.title: Wash plate (after primary)
steps.instruction: Wash the wells four times with 200 µL PBS‑0.1 % Tween as before and dry the plate.

steps.title: Add secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL secondary antibody solution to each well, remove bubbles, and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.

steps.title: Wash plate (after secondary)
steps.instruction: Wash the wells five times with 200 µL PBS‑0.1 % Tween, drying the plate after the final wash.

steps.title: Develop color
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL fast‑kinetic TMB substrate to each well swiftly, then incubate at room temperature for 25–30 min (up to 1 h is permissible). Monitor the blue color; stop before saturation.

steps.title: Stop reaction
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 450 nm stop solution to each well; the solution turns yellow, halting development.

steps.title: Read plate
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 450 nm on a plate reader within 30 min of adding stop solution. Keep the plate sealed to avoid evaporation if reading is delayed.
